case.name: materialized_after_points
case.sql: SELECT count(*),sum(x) FROM (WITH q AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t.seq AS x,t.seq AS seq,t.grp AS grp FROM t WHERE t.grp<1024 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u WHERE u.id=t.seq AND u.v>=t.v)) SELECT a.x+b.x AS x FROM q a JOIN q b USING(seq));
case.prepare: WITH RECURSIVE c(i) AS (VALUES(1) UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM c WHERE i<1000) SELECT sum((SELECT v FROM t WHERE id=printf('%016x', 1+(c.i*2654435761)%65536))) FROM c;
